answer: Proof of Stake secures AI agent networks by requiring agents to lock collateral, ensuring each identity represents a financial relic of actual capital. Like a karst topography where water creates unique voids, stake distribution limits identity creation. An attacker attempting a Sybil attack atop a digital knoll of network influence must bear the prohibitive cost of slashing their assets, making the creation of thousands of fake nodes economically unsustainable for any adversary lacking sufficient market share.
